environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with no additional request filtering. The ALB forwards all HTTP traffic to the container on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, and ALB to container on 8080. No additional middleware or proxy-level inspection is configured. SQLite database is writable on the container's ephemeral storage at /app/data/users.db.

config.alb_rules: default action: forward to target group
